related.title: Autopsy 4.22：雜湊集合版本與路徑、內容的雙重分母
related.titleEn: Autopsy 4.22: hash-set versions and separate path/content denominators
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付body-fixture.txt、attribute-observations.csv、grouped-times.csv與filesystem-semantics.md，清楚保存每個群的來源屬性。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver body-fixture.txt, attribute-observations.csv, grouped-times.csv and filesystem-semantics.md. Each grouped record must retain its complete source-attribute membership and the limitations on interpreting it as activity.
related.difference: 建立路徑到內容雜湊的映射，固定雜湊集合版本及類別；同時報告路徑覆蓋與唯一內容覆蓋，保留未命中的檔案。
related.differenceEn: Build a path-to-content-hash mapping, pin the hash-set version and classification, and report both path coverage and unique-content coverage while retaining all unmatched files for further review.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: mactime將body file的時間資料整理為時間線；MACB代表不同時間屬性，具體語意隨檔案系統而異，相同時間不必然相同事件。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 10個合成檔案，各有4個已知時間欄位，共40觀測；其中6檔四欄相同，其餘4檔四欄皆不同。群鍵為檔案ID加時間值。 按檔案與時間群組得到6×1+4×4=22群；40/22=1.818182只是觀測對群比例，不是動作去重的真實倍率。

Autopsy雜湊查找比對指定集合，集合內容改變可能需要重跑處理；命中表示與集合中內容相符，不證明環境、用途或執行行為無害。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 有100條路徑、80個唯一內容雜湊；集合v1命中50個內容，分布在65條路徑。所有數值為人工可列舉的合成集合。 路徑命中率65/100=65%，內容命中率50/80=62.5%；兩者分母不同，不能把其中一個稱為完整安全率。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: mactime organizes temporal fields from a body file into a timeline. MACB denotes different timestamp attributes whose exact meaning depends on the filesystem; equal timestamps need not imply one shared underlying operation. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Ten synthetic files each have four known time attributes, totaling forty observations. Six files have four equal values; four have four distinct values. Group by file identity and timestamp value. Grouping by file and timestamp produces 6×1+4×4=22 groups. The 40/22=1.818182 ratio compares observations to groups; it is not a verified deduplication factor for user actions.

Autopsy hash lookup compares files with configured sets, and changed sets may require ingest to run again. A match associates content with a set; it does not prove harmless context, use or execution behavior. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. There are 100 paths and eighty unique content hashes. Set v1 matches fifty distinct contents spread across sixty-five paths. Construct explicit synthetic sets so every count can be enumerated and checked. Path hit rate is 65/100=65%, while content hit rate is 50/80=62.5%. The denominators differ, and neither quantity is a comprehensive measure of security or benignness.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.titleEn: Velero 1.17: restore dependencies and application-verification critical paths

Each grouped record must retain its complete source-attribute membership and the limitations on interpreting it as activity.
related.difference: 建立namespace、CRD、volume、workload及驗證五種工作，計算最早開始與完成；區分物件建立、資料可讀與服務驗收。
related.differenceEn: Model namespace, CRD, volume, workload and verification tasks with earliest starts and finishes. Distinguish object creation, readable application data and service acceptance instead of using one restore-status label.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

Velero還原有資源次序與外掛相關行為；本課工作時間及平行性是合成計畫，並不宣稱Velero會依此自動排程或保證應用一致性。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 namespace2分鐘與CRD3分鐘可同時開始；volume4分鐘在namespace後；workload2分鐘需CRD與volume完成；驗證3分鐘在workload後。 volume於6分鐘完成，workload於8，驗證於11；串列相加14分鐘會忽略允許平行，只有8分鐘則漏掉應用驗證。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: mactime organizes temporal fields from a body file into a timeline. MACB denotes different timestamp attributes whose exact meaning depends on the filesystem; equal timestamps need not imply one shared underlying operation. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Ten synthetic files each have four known time attributes, totaling forty observations. Six files have four equal values; four have four distinct values. Group by file identity and timestamp value. Grouping by file and timestamp produces 6×1+4×4=22 groups. The 40/22=1.818182 ratio compares observations to groups; it is not a verified deduplication factor for user actions.

Velero restoration has resource ordering and plugin-dependent behavior. Durations and parallelism below define a synthetic plan, not a claim that Velero automatically uses this schedule or guarantees application consistency. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Namespace takes two minutes and CRD three, starting in parallel. Volume takes four after namespace; workload takes two after both CRD and volume; verification takes three after workload. Volume finishes at minute six, workload at eight and verification at eleven. Summing every duration serially gives fourteen and ignores permitted parallelism; stopping at eight omits application verification.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
